videos.title: Minimalist Shelf Audit: 3 Moisturisers, 1 Keeper | Rosebank

scenes.caption: Three moisturisers go in. One stays.
scenes.say: Minimalist shelf, Rosebank style. Three moisturisers go in, and only one stays. Let's audit.

scenes.caption: General product info, not medical advice.
scenes.say: Quick note: this is general product information, not medical advice.

scenes.caption: One clear job per product.
scenes.say: The audit rule is simple. Every product on the shelf needs one clear job. Read the description, then ask: does that job match what my skin needs?

scenes.caption: skin smoothing cream: 48 hours of continuous hydration
scenes.say: Candidate one: skin smoothing cream. Its description promises forty-eight hours of continuous hydration, powered by Active HydraMesh Technology and a hyaluronic acid complex, with grape seed extract and vitamins C and E. The texture is described as rich and creamy, without a greasy finish.

scenes.caption: calm water gel: weightless water-gel for dry, sensitive skin
scenes.say: Candidate two: calm water gel. A weightless water-gel moisturiser for dry, sensitive skin. It turns into a skin-quenching fluid as you apply it, and dual hyaluronic acid works to increase and lock in moisture.

scenes.caption: skin soothing hydrating lotion: sheer, lightweight, face and neck, day and night
scenes.say: Candidate three: skin soothing hydrating lotion. A sheer, lightweight moisturiser that helps soothe discomfort and hydrate areas that feel dry, with plant-based squalane, hyaluronic acid, and gentle botanicals including ginger, orange and grapefruit. Apply over face and neck, day and night.

scenes.caption: Rich cream, weightless gel or sheer lotion: match the texture to the job.
scenes.say: So which one stays? Rich and creamy, weightless gel, or sheer lotion. Keep the texture and the job that match your skin, and give the shelf space back.

scenes.caption: Check the full ingredient list on the product page.
scenes.say: Sensitive skin, or not sure? Read the full ingredient list on the product page before you buy.

videos.theme: Westville beginner body wash vs body cream shopping walkthrough
videos.title: Body Wash or Body Cream? A Beginner's Walkthrough | Westville

scenes.caption: First time buying body care? Start here.
scenes.say: New to body care, and shopping in Westville this weekend? Body wash or body cream? Here's the walkthrough before you buy.

scenes.caption: General product info, not medical advice.
scenes.say: Quick note: this is general product information, not medical advice.

scenes.caption: Know the job: wash cleanses, cream hydrates.
scenes.say: Step one: know the job. A wash cleanses in the shower. A cream hydrates afterwards. They aren't substitutes for each other.

scenes.caption: conditioning body wash, 295 ml: soap-free, gently cleansing
scenes.say: Conditioning body wash comes in a two hundred and ninety-five millilitre bottle. It's a soap-free, gently cleansing formula with Pro-Vitamin B5, and aromatic oils of French rosemary, Chinese eucalyptus, tea tree and lemon.

scenes.caption: Work into a lather, rinse, then moisturise.
scenes.say: Work it into a lather, then rinse. Even the product page says it's still recommended to hydrate with a moisturiser after showering.

scenes.caption: body hydrating cream, 295 ml: silky, medium-weight
scenes.say: Body hydrating cream is also two hundred and ninety-five millilitres. It's a silky, medium-weight cream, with naturally derived lactic acid and hydroxy acid extracts from cane sugar and apple to smooth skin and relieve dryness, plus orange oil and Chinese green tea.

scenes.caption: Smooth onto the body morning and night, after showering.
scenes.say: Smooth it onto the body morning and night. It can go on straight after showering or bathing.

scenes.caption: Essential oils may give a natural scent. Known sensitivity? Patch test first.
scenes.say: Both list essential oils, which may give a natural scent. If you have a known sensitivity to an ingredient, the product pages suggest a patch test first.

scenes.caption: Buying one? Pick what's missing. Buying both? Wash, then cream.
scenes.say: Buying just one? Decide what's missing from your routine: the cleanse, or the moisture. Buying both? Wash first, then cream.

scenes.say: Both are linked at skincare dot durban, and in the description. Subscribe for more beginner walkthroughs.

videos.title: Serum Label Detective: 3 Clues on One Label | Bedfordview

scenes.caption: Three clues hidden on one serum label.
scenes.say: Picked up a serum in Bedfordview, and the label reads like code? Let's play detective. Three clues, one label.

scenes.caption: Not dermatologists or doctors. General product info, not medical advice.
scenes.say: Good to know: dermatology dot joburg isn't run by dermatologists or doctors, and this is general product information, not medical advice.

scenes.caption: AGE Bright Clearing Serum, 30 ml
scenes.say: Today's case: AGE Bright Clearing Serum, thirty millilitres. Its description: an active two-in-one serum that clears and helps prevent breakouts, while reducing visible skin ageing.

scenes.caption: Salicylic acid: 2.0%
scenes.say: Clue one: the number. The product page lists salicylic acid at two point zero percent.

scenes.caption: Niacinamide appears second, right after water.
scenes.say: Clue two: the ingredient list. Niacinamide appears second, straight after water. Further down sits the white shiitake mushroom extract the description pairs it with, for a brighter, more even-looking skin tone.

scenes.caption: Thin layer, let it dry, under moisturiser, up to twice a day.
scenes.say: Clue three: the directions. Apply a thin layer and allow it to dry. Use it under your moisturiser, up to twice a day, as needed.

scenes.caption: Sensitive skin: build up slowly. Sensitive to salicylic acid: patch test or avoid.
scenes.say: And the fine print. People with sensitive skin may want to build up to daily use. Anyone sensitive to salicylic acid may want to patch test first, or avoid it.

scenes.caption: Number, list position, directions. Read all three before you buy.
scenes.say: Case closed. A number, a list position, and a line of directions tell you most of the story. Read all three before you buy.

scenes.caption: Linked at dermatology.joburg and in the description.
scenes.say: The serum is linked at dermatology dot joburg, and in the description. Subscribe for the next case.

videos.title: Sunscreen Label Scavenger Hunt: 5 Things to Find | Cape Town

thumb.title: 5 things to find on a sunscreen label

scenes.caption: Five things to find on a sunscreen label.
scenes.say: Packing an outdoor bag in Cape Town? Before you go, run this sunscreen label scavenger hunt. Five things to find.

scenes.caption: Not dermatologists or doctors. General product info, not medical advice.
scenes.say: Good to know: dermatology dot capetown isn't run by dermatologists or doctors, and this is general product information, not medical advice.

scenes.caption: Our example: clearing defense SPF30
scenes.say: Find one: the SPF number. Our example, clearing defense SPF thirty, puts it right in the name.

scenes.caption: "Broad Spectrum sunscreen defends against UV rays"
scenes.say: Find two: the words broad spectrum. The product page describes broad spectrum sunscreen that defends against UV rays.

scenes.caption: Homosalate 8% · Octocrylene 8% · Octisalate 5% · Avobenzone 3%
scenes.say: Find three: the active filters. Here they're listed as homosalate, eight percent. Octocrylene, eight percent. Octisalate, five percent. And avobenzone, three percent.

scenes.caption: Generous amount, face and neck, about 30 min before sun. Reapply as recommended.
scenes.say: Find four: the directions. Apply a generous amount to cleansed face and neck, preferably thirty minutes before sun exposure, and reapply as recommended.

scenes.caption: Shine-reducing matte SPF moisturiser for breakout-prone skin
scenes.say: Find five: who it suits. It's a shine-reducing, matte SPF moisturiser for breakout-prone skin. The page also notes very dry skin may feel drier, and suggests layering a hydrating lotion underneath.

scenes.caption: All five found? Into the bag, with a hat and some shade.
scenes.say: Five for five? Then it goes in the bag, along with a hat and some shade.
